grants.label: Offering to the Unseen
grants.scope: Diplomacy to Make an Impression, Request or otherwise negotiate with the spirit

warps.text: Affect up to three spirits within range

system.description:
SHAMAN SPIRIT UTILITY
Shaman Specialist Spell
Cast 1 minute (material, verbal)
Range 30 feet
Targets 1 spirit possessing sufficient awareness to communicate
Duration 10 minutes

You create a spiritual offering appropriate to the target: remembered food, a scent, music, warmth, a symbolic possession or another intangible experience meaningful to it.
You gain a +2-status bonus to Diplomacy checks made to Make an Impression, Request or otherwise negotiate with that spirit for the duration.
The spell does not compel the spirit to negotiate, change its attitude automatically or force it to accept a request. A spirit incapable of desire, memory or meaningful communication cannot benefit from the offering.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Affect up to three spirits within range.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
